---
title: "Add Askr"
---

`0.4.2` is the current release. The public format is `askr-html`. Quiet Quartz
is the visual theme.

```bash
quarto add arfiligol/askr@v0.4.2
```

```yaml
project:
  type: website

website:
  title: Project Name
  site-url: https://example.github.io/project/

format:
  askr-html:
    toc: true
    toc-title: Sections
    toc-location: right
```

The installed copy lives at `_extensions/arfiligol/askr`. Askr does not fetch
fonts, icons, or styles from a CDN.

To move to a newer tag, install that tag and render the project again. Commit
the updated `_extensions` copy. Reinstall a reviewed tag instead of editing
files inside `_extensions/arfiligol/askr`.

## Quarto compatibility — 0.5.0 candidate

The candidate supports stable Quarto releases in `>=1.9.38 <1.11`.
Quarto 1.10.18 remains the reproducible gallery and CI baseline; consumers
may use a stable release inside the supported range instead of that exact patch.
The currently published 0.4.2 tag still declares its original requirement.

Actual non-executing renders and browser observations cover stable 1.9.38
and 1.10.18, plus 1.10.16 as a diagnostic prerelease across upstream Sass
changes. This is not an observation of every intervening patch or a promise
that prereleases are supported. The native grouped-tab runtime, Bootstrap tab
implementation and tabset markup used by Askr were unchanged at the inspected
boundaries. Exact inputs, findings and limits are recorded in
[the validation receipt](../VALIDATION.md).

Before extending the range, inspect upstream changes to native tabs, theme
switching, navigation/search and grid markup, then render and operate the
affected Askr components using the proposed version. Quarto 1.11 is excluded
from this candidate because it changes navigation and theme-control markup;
support requires its own investigation, not a multi-version adapter framework.
